key_takeaways: Mix with Basic Substances? Let us investigate by performing the following experiment.
2.10a)? Slowly add drops of lime water to this test tube with the help of a dropper and swirl it well.
Again, add one drop of lemon juice to the above solution.
When lime water is added to this test tube, the colour of the solution eventually changes from red to blue.
This shows that the solution in the test tube is no longer acidic.
